//Embed 'asmjit' as an interface library (no static/shared library)
ASMJIT_EMBED:BOOL=OFF

//Disable AArch64 backend
ASMJIT_NO_AARCH64:BOOL=OFF

//Disable the use of inline ABI namespace {asmjit::v...}
ASMJIT_NO_ABI_NAMESPACE:BOOL=OFF

//Disable AsmJit's Builder emitter (build feature)
ASMJIT_NO_BUILDER:BOOL=OFF

//Disable AsmJit's Compiler emitter (build feature)
ASMJIT_NO_COMPILER:BOOL=OFF

//Disable extra compilation flags added by AsmJit to its targets
ASMJIT_NO_CUSTOM_FLAGS:BOOL=OFF

//Disable all foreign backends (enables only a backend that matches
// the target)
ASMJIT_NO_FOREIGN:BOOL=OFF

//Disable instruction validation and introspection API (build feature)
ASMJIT_NO_INTROSPECTION:BOOL=OFF

//Disable VirtMem, JitAllocator, and JitRuntime at build time
ASMJIT_NO_JIT:BOOL=OFF

//Disable logging features (build feature)
ASMJIT_NO_LOGGING:BOOL=OFF

//Disable natvis support (embedding asmjit.natvis in PDB)
ASMJIT_NO_NATVIS:BOOL=OFF

//Disable the use of shm_open() (some platforms have better options)
ASMJIT_NO_SHM_OPEN:BOOL=OFF

//Disable textual representation of instructions, enums, cpu features,
// ...
ASMJIT_NO_TEXT:BOOL=OFF
